notes.title: 📣 Game Launch 🎊 – *Special Launch Discount for a Limited Time! 🏷️🛒📅
notes.content:
[h1]Ankhway: The Interplanetary Legacy is oficcially out now on Steam![/h1][quote][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175856/13bb1cba4048e88f15554992e814c3e4b62a0b0e.png"][/img][strike]-[/strike] We're excited to finally release the videogame and share it with all of you. To celebrate the launch, we're offering a special price with 20% discount available for the first 14 days only! 🚀


🎮  Whether you're a longtime fan of the [i]indie videogames[/i] or just discovering it, this is the perfect time to jump in. 

🧭 [b]Genre[/b]: [i]Adventure, Action and Sci-Fi.[/i] [/p][p]
💬 We’d love to hear your feedback, reviews, and see your gameplay screenshots or videos!
      (If you find any problem or want to ask something, you can send an email to: 
     [url="https://ankhwayvideogamecontact@gmail.com)"]ankhwayvideogamecontact@gmail.com)[/url][/p][h3]

*[b][i]This price (4,99$ and 20% of discount for the game release) is a [/i]special launch price[i]. After the first 14 days, the game will be priced at $7.99.[/i][/b][/h3][p]
